tool_descriptions.python: Run Python 3.12 (pandas, duckdb available) in a sandbox. Files: data/ (payments.csv, fees.json, merchant_data.json, merchant_category_codes.csv, acquirer_countries.csv, manual.md) and skills/ (helper scripts of this harness version). No network. Print what you need; output is truncated at 8 KB. EACH CALL IS A FRESH PROCESS: variables, imports and DataFrames from earlier calls do NOT exist. Write one self-contained script per call (load data, compute, print), or save intermediates to files (e.g. df.to_parquet('x.parquet')) and load them in the next call; files persist within this conversation. A call is killed after 60 s: vectorise with pandas/duckdb, never loop over every transaction × fee rule in pure Python.
